ns2:course.label: Adv Topics Latina/o Studies
ns2:course.description: Examines specific topics in Latina/Latino Studies not addressed in regularly offered courses. Examples include theories of ethnic identity, historical foundations, cultural expression, and relevant topics in public policy studies of Latina/Latino communities. May be repeated in the same or separate terms to a maximum of 6 hours.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated in the same or separate terms to a maximum of 6 hours.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Sophomore, Junior, or Senior class standing.
